items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Eben Ahbez was running around Vine Street

ctx.x: Eben Ahbez was running around Vine Street

Yeah, yeah. Mother asked me last night, she say that building that's circular. Circular out there that's King Cole and Frank Sinatra. What building is that? I say that's the building that Nat Cole and Frank Sinatra built, it's the Capitol Recording Studios. And office building.
